properties.name: V Line — Valley Boulevard
properties.description: Heavy rail from Union Station via César Chávez and Mission Road to Valley Boulevard, continuing through the San Gabriel Valley to Holt Avenue in Pomona. SC19 connects V and H via Soto; SC39 on Griffin has a walking transfer at Valley/Mission.
properties.alignment_status: conceptual grade-separated metro corridor; road centerlines are a geographic reference
properties.concept_headway_note: Design target, not a timetable or a fleet/capacity calculation
properties.operating_note: Conceptual grade-separated service with 23 stations from Union Station to Pomona. Headway is a design target, not a simulated timetable.
properties.station_spacing_policy: Long-distance heavy rail: widely spaced stations at major corridors and transfers, rather than streetcar stop spacing.

properties.name: RO Line — Roscoe
properties.description: Roscoe heavy rail from Reseda to Tuxford/Lankershim, connecting R at Reseda and local Balboa and Lankershim streetcars.
properties.alignment_status: conceptual grade-separated metro corridor; road centerlines are a geographic reference
properties.concept_headway_note: Design target, not a timetable or a fleet/capacity calculation
properties.station_spacing_policy: Heavy rail: fewer stations at major streets and transfers, with wider spacing than streetcar service.
properties.operating_note: Conceptual heavy rail with 10 stations; headway is a design target, not an operating simulation.
